traits.name: Bark Orders
traits.text: ⬻ (auditory, linguistic); The gnoll sergeant commands its allies to reposition. Any allies who hear and understand this order can use a reaction to Step.

traits.name: Pack Attack
traits.text: A gnoll hunter deals 1d4 (1d4) extra damage to any creature that's within reach of at least two of the gnoll hunter's allies.

traits.name: Rugged Travel
traits.text: A gnoll ignores the first square of difficult terrain it moves into each time it Steps or Strides.
